analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 43.2 remains in neutral territory, and MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative. The 5-day low of $142.28 matches the 20-day low of $142.28, forming a Higher Low pattern. Current price is near the upper bound of the 52-week range at 51.4% and approaching the resistance of $161.45. Considering ATR of 5.84%, a 1.3x ATR stop loss ($12.25) would be $148.93, and a 2.6x ATR target ($24.50) would be $185.68, resulting in a risk-reward ratio below 1.5. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
